data.title: Add a manual `ekumen decision apply` until the loop exists
data.question: A decided decision keeps blocking its tasks until DecisionApplied (C-decision-record §3), which only the loop writes, and no CLI command writes it. Until T-reconcile ships, every task gated by a decided decision stays blocked. How should decisions be applied before then?

options.tradeoff: Add `ekumen decision apply <id>`, run by the orchestrator as `--as loop:<session>`. It writes DecisionApplied and the §B amendments. Small minor addition to C-cli-json.
No change. T-reconcile becomes urgent, and statuses read "blocked" for decided work until it ships.
Treat decided as cleared in core. Simplest, but it changes C-decision-record §3 semantics.

context.summary: Seen in the end-to-end run: after `decision answer`, the task stays "blocked" by the decision. The orchestrator can't clear it with `task block --remove` either, because core also blocks through the decision's own `blocks`.
